question: Each game in table tennis consists of how many points?
solution:
The correct answer is __**11**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Each game in table tennis consists of 11 points.
 
• A player must win by at least a 2-point margin to win the game, so if both players reach 10 points, the game continues until one player leads by 2 points.
 
• A match in table tennis is typically played in a best-of-five or best-of-seven format, depending on the level of competition.
 
• This means the first player to win three games (in a best-of-five) or four games (in a best-of-seven) wins the match.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Sport
 Points per Game/Set
 Required Margin to Win
 Tie-Breaker/Deuce Rule
 
 
 
 

 Table Tennis
 11 points
 2-point margin
 Continues until a 2-point lead (e.g., 12-10)
 
 

 Badminton
 21 points
 2-point margin
 Continues until a 2-point lead, capped at 30-29
 
 

 Volleyball
 25 points (Final set: 15 points)
 2-point margin
 Continues until a 2-point lead (e.g., 26-24)
 
 

 Tennis
 4 points per game, 6 games per set
 2-point lead in games and points
 Tie-breaker at 6-6 (7 points, 2-point lead)
 
 

 Squash
 11 points
 2-point margin
 Continues until a 2-point lead (e.g., 12-10)
 
 

 Basketball
 Time-based scoring (points per basket)
 No margin required in regulation
 Overtime if tied at the end of regulation time
